title: Metric types, labels, and the cardinality that blows up the bill

videos.script: A metric looks like one number. Underneath, it is a family of series, one for every combination of its labels. {{family}} This lesson is about that family. First the four kinds of metric, and the one question each kind can answer. A counter that only grows. A gauge that goes up and down. A histogram that counts requests into buckets, and guesses everything finer than a bucket. {{types}} Then the experiment. Twenty thousand logins, counted twice. Once by plan, which makes three series. Once by user, which makes forty thousand. {{experiment}} You watch Prometheus's memory climb, find the culprit with one request, and drop it. And you see why the drop is a stopgap, and the fix belongs in the code. {{fix}}
